verdict.rationale: Sierra documents a first-party Agent SDK that lets teams write customer journeys as code, plus CI/CD-based publishing, so agent building and deployment has a programmatic path alongside the no-code Agent Studio UI. Nothing shows an API covering the rest of the UI (knowledge editing, Explorer, Insights, Live Assist), and probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: a documented public API reference, evidence of API parity for knowledge management, analytics/Explorer and release governance, and independent confirmation of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: write customer journeys as code, track changes, and build sophisticated logic without giving up our development workflows
Make your agent available on ChatGPT with the push of a button, or via CI/CD.
